text:
maria: Heads up — eu-west-1a dedicated pool is seeing a sharp p99 latency increase (~100-300ms above baseline) and a lot of eviction churn. Tenants report request timeouts. KV cache miss rate spiked. Investigating now. :rotating_light:

deploy-bot: Alert: [eu-west-1a] pool_latency_p99 > SLA threshold (1.2s). Incident created: INC-1964000001.

jonas: On it. can you paste profiler dump and recent kernel-selector logs? suspect fallback kernels or wide batch packing.

maria: paste: ```
2026-03-17T09:12:14Z kernel_selector: chose kernel=matmul_fallback_q4 for model=gpt-small v2 (reason=quant-fallback)
2026-03-17T09:12:14Z batching: packed_batch_tokens=3720 packed_requests=24 max_allowed=2048
2026-03-17T09:12:15Z kvcache: miss_rate=0.63 eviction_rate=0.42
2026-03-17T09:12:16Z scheduler: tenant=acme-corp concurrency=96 (cap=unbounded)
```

kevin: That bundling looks wrong — packed_tokens >> model max sequence. We had the new batching heuristic enabled in eu-west yesterday to improve throughput. If it packs too many requests, KV sets thrash and kernel switches to slower fallback kernels (quant/fallback path).

rachel: Confirmed from tracing: when kernel_selector falls back we see ~2.5x token compute time and the runtime also increases mem-pressure -> more evictions.

tara: Quick check on capacity side: I see one tenant (acme-corp) with reserved capacity flag misconfigured — they have a burst policy set to true which bypasses the per-tenant soft cap. That plus the packing change likely oversubscribed the pool.

jonas: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) disable new batching heuristic in eu-west, 2) force kernel_selector to prefer native kernels when kvcache_miss_rate > 0.25, 3) apply emergency per-tenant concurrency cap for acme-corp to 32.

maria: Doing 1 & 3 now. rolling batch heuristic -> OFF on eu-west-1a. applying tenant cap for acme-corp to 32.

kevin: Also push a temporary kernel-selector hotfix: if packed_batch_tokens > 2048 then reduce packing target by 50% and prefer stable kernels. I can ship a small config change.

maria: Patch applied for tenant cap and rolled back heuristic. Initial telemetry: p99 dropped ~120ms within 90s, eviction_rate down to 0.12. KV miss rate trending down.

tara: I fixed the reserved/burst flag on acme-corp and created a guard in the quota service to block combination of reserved=true + burst=true.

jonas: Filed follow-up: INV-3421 — investig root cause + tests for batching heuristic + kernel selector canary thresholds. Owners: @jonas (runtime), @kevin (heuristics), @tara (quota).

rachel: Notes for postmortem: timeline, graphs for kv miss vs p99, change that enabled packing, tenant config error. Suggest a new integration test simulating KV miss -> ensure packing reduces.

maria: For now incident mitigated. Will keep monitoring for 2h then close if stable. Thank you all. :thumbsup:
